findings.message: Expose the Apple API key ID as a create option. For non-interactive iOS destination creation using API-key authentication, `appleApiKeyId` is always undefined: it is initialized locally and has no corresponding command option. Consequently, the command uploads the key file and then unconditionally exits here, even when all available authentication flags are supplied. Add an `appleApiKeyId` option and read it from `options` so this authentication method works in CI.
